releases.title: The Final Spark is here
notes: You wake in a sewer, get found by a rat, and choose your way through The Final Spark, a story told in short videos.
Each choice opens a new page with its own video, and your choices lead to many different endings.
The story now has its full set of voices, ambience, sound effects and music.
Security camera feeds show the building in every state the story calls for.
Your progress is saved, so you can pick up The Final Spark right where you left off, on a computer or a phone.

releases.title: Smoother blog browsing
notes: Moving between blog posts no longer shows the loading screen over the post you are reading.

releases.title: Story cards, bigger buttons, tidier blog
notes: Completed stories on the Canon page show a Start Over button again.
The Play, Tree, and settings gear buttons are easier to tap, especially on phones.
Rows in the blog sidebar now line up neatly.

releases.title: New in this update
notes: Completed stories on the Canon page now show a Play button instead of Start Over.

releases.title: New in this update
notes: Blog: add "Upgrade and a downgrade too!" (Oct 18, 2026)

releases.title: No going back, Start Over on finished stories
notes: There is no Back button in a story any more: a choice stands. If you die, Try again; at an ending, Start Over.
Completed stories on the landing page show a Start Over button.

releases.title: A home page of stories
notes: The home page now lists every story as a card: choose one to play.
A new story, The Water Road, joins The Final Spark.
Each card shows whether you have not started, started or completed the story, and how much of it you have explored.

releases.title: The Final Spark is on the air
notes: Wake in the sewer and choose your way out, one scene at a time.
Every choice plays its own scene, and Back lets you take the other turn.
The Tree tab shows how far the story branches.
